violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ONSITE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at handwashing sink AT FRONT KITCHEN NEAR COFFEE MACHINES.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC ADDED SOAP DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED WITH SOAP AND TOWELS.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sinks ACROSS FROM OVENS AND FRONT KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED PAPER TOWELS DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE AWLAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED WITH SOAP AND TOWELS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CREAM BRIOCHES AT 43-50F AND STRAWBERRY CROISSANTS AT 41-54F IN THE LEFT TWO-DOOR SLIDING DISPLAY CASE. OBSERVED SMOKED SAUSAGE BREAD AT 47F AND PASTRY FRANKS AT 43-47F IN THE RIGHT TWO-DOOR SLIDING DISPLAY CASE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC AGREED TO DISCARD OF THESE FOOD ITEMS OUT OF TEMPERATURE WITHIN A TOTAL OF FOUR HOURS. FOODS IN THE BACK OF THE CASE WERE OBSERVED TO BE MUCH COLDER THAN THE FRONT (DUE TO FREQUENT OPEN/CLOSING FROM CUSTOMERS). PIC WILL ADJUST THE COOLERS TO BE COLDER/CONTACT A TECHNICIAN TO ENSURE THE COOLERS ARE COLD HOLDING PROPERLY.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE LEFT SLIDING TWO-DOOR DISPLAY CASE AT 37-46F AND THE RIGHT SLIDING TWO-DOOR DISPLAY CASE AT 40-49F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC WILL ENSURE THE COOLERS ARE ADJUSTED TO BE COLDER (CONSISTENTLY BETWEEN 34-38F) AND WILL CONTACT A REPAIR TECHNICIAN TO ENSURE THE COOLERS ARE WORKING PROPERLY. FOOD ITEMS IN THE BACK OF THE COOLER WERE OBSERVED TO BE COLDER THAN THE FRONT.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED Y-SPLITTER INSTALLED AT THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC FOUND APPROVED SPLITTER ONSITE DURING THE INSPECTION AND WILL ENSURE IT IS INSTALLED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
